verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Skyvern serves a live llms.txt at skyvern.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an agent-oriented product summary, and a skyvern.com/llms page lists capabilities in an agent-readable form. A machine-readable OpenAPI document at api.skyvern.com/openapi.json adds further structured docs. missing for 10: markdown versions of the docs (docs.md returns 404), evidence of how complete or deep the llms.txt content is (e.g. an llms-full.txt or linked doc index), independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
